post.description: Creates a product-scoped order and returns the provider payment URL when applicable. tenantId is required for every product because purchase eligibility is verified against external tenant membership.

requestBody.description: Order creation input. Product identity is always derived from the integration token. tenantId is always required for user-api purchase-eligibility verification.

userId.description: External SaaS user identifier mirrored into Billing.

tenantId.description: External tenant that owns and pays for the order. Required for every product so user-api can verify tenant membership.

orderType.description: Purchase type. Exactly one matching target field is required; target fields for other order types are rejected.

planId.description: Required and only allowed when orderType is SUBSCRIPTION.

boosterPackId.description: Required and only allowed when orderType is BOOSTER_PACK.

amountCents.description: Required and only allowed for RECHARGE. Amount in the smallest currency unit; capped below the signed 32-bit database boundary.

idempotencyKey.description: Required caller-generated idempotency key. Reuse it for every retry of the same logical order.

channel.description: Payment channel. Availability depends on order type and deployment configuration.

billingPeriod.description: Optional only for SUBSCRIPTION; omission means monthly.

successUrl.description: Browser redirect after successful payment. Allowed for STRIPE and ALIPAY only; its origin must be allowlisted for the product.

cancelUrl.description: Browser redirect after cancelled payment. Allowed for STRIPE only; its origin must be allowlisted for the product.

allOf.description: Exactly one purchase target is allowed and it must match orderType.
Browser callback fields are restricted by payment channel.

post.description: Mirrors the external subject, establishes product entitlement state, and creates or reuses a virtual API key. The idempotency key is scoped to the token-derived product; exact replays return the durable receipt, while a different normalized request with the same key returns HTTP 409. tenant.id is required except for a self-operated CODING_PLAN product whose subject is explicitly per-user. PAY_AS_YOU_GO and provider_resale CODING_PLAN never create a free entitlement through this operation; unknown Coding fulfillment modes fail closed.

requestBody.description: Provisioning snapshot. Product identity is derived exclusively from the integration token.

idempotencyKey.description: Required caller-generated idempotency key, scoped to the token-derived product. Retry the same normalized request with the same key; reusing it for a different request returns HTTP 409.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: Version timestamp of the external user snapshot. It must not be more than five minutes in the future.

id.description: External SaaS tenant identifier. Required except for self-operated CODING_PLAN user-only products.

type.description: Tenant type. Only personal and team are accepted.

name.description: Virtual API key name. If supplied, it must equal the fixed product-scoped name saas:{token-derived-productSlug}:virtual.

allowedModels.description: Optional model allowlist for the virtual API key. A non-null list must contain at least one model; an empty list is rejected rather than treated as unrestricted.

rotate.description: Rotate an existing Partner-managed key. Key policy changes require true. An exact replay with the same idempotency key returns the original durable result and never rotates again.

ensureFreePlan.description: For SUBSCRIPTION and self-operated CODING_PLAN (platform_model_package), omission/null/true ensures the default/free entitlement and false skips it. For PAY_AS_YOU_GO and provider_resale CODING_PLAN, omission/null/false skips automatic entitlement creation (provider_resale requires an existing active entitlement) and true is rejected with HTTP 400. Unknown or unconfigured CODING_PLAN fulfillment modes fail closed.

201.description: Tenant provisioned. A newly generated secret is recoverable on exact replays for at most 15 minutes.
